answer: Open entry can still make Sybils costly. First, newcomers lock a refundable 9 POA bond. Second, three random established peers inspect signed activity and attest independently. Third, release the bond after two useful epochs; reward peers only for accepted work. Fourth, linked control signals trigger review; proven duplicates forfeit the bond and wait a season. A 600-account farm locks 5,400 POA and pays 36 POA for 1,800 attestations at 0.02 each. Basalt anchors the records, dune hides duplicates, and haven shelters honest peers—like a lighthouse sorting real ships from fog.
